name: benchBoth
description: benchBoth is a heterogeneous Hugging Face dataset that aggregates both multiple-choice and open-ended text tasks to evaluate language models on classification and generative responses. It is designed for quick, mixed-format evaluations rather than large-scale leaderboard benchmarking. The collection emphasizes practical, small-to-moderate sized test sets for comparative model assessment.
reputation: Small community dataset with limited adoption; used mainly for ad-hoc or preliminary evaluations rather than standardized benchmarks.
